name: Change of Status to F-1 — College (General)
name_pt: Mudança de Status para F-1 — College (Geral)
name_es: Cambio de Estatus a F-1 — College (General)
note: COS to F-1 for a college/university program (as opposed to a language school) -- a distinct pricing product from the F-1/F-2 Language School tier (cos_to_f1/cos_to_f2) even though all three share the same underlying I-539 filing type. Also distinct from the partnership-priced version (cos_to_f1_college_partnership) -- never conflate the two, per SAES_Master_Contratos_Servicos.md section 29.2.

pricing.notes: General COS contract's College modality -- not the partnership-priced product.

standard_includes: Complete checklist of documents and information
Google Drive link for document uploads
Review and organization of supporting documents
Preparation of the Change of Status Cover Letter, based on 18 years of experience
Recommendation of two college options based on location, schedule, and cost
plus_includes: Translation of the address letter, sponsor/sponsorship letter, and employer letter
Client pays only the USCIS filing fee
$15 convenience fee waived when the SAES card is used to pay SEVIS, USCIS, or school fees
plus_excludes: School fees (registration, enrollment, change of status)
